chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr and Fadalah, from Jamil, from Zurarah and Abi Basir, from Abi Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
A kiss does not invalidate the fast.

key_terms.الصَّوْمَ: the fast; the state of ritual fasting

ai.seo_question: Does kissing invalidate the fast in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling that a kiss, in itself, does not invalidate sawm (fasting). It is relevant to the fiqh of fasting and clarifies a practical matter concerning the actions of a fasting person.
